tracks.title: DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer
tracks.summary: Build, ship and run software reliably: from the shell to SLOs and blameless postmortems.
tracks.capstone: Take a small service from a laptop to production: CI that fails fast, infrastructure as code, a canary deploy, RED dashboards, a 99.9% SLO with its error budget, and a blameless postmortem from a game day.

tracks.title: Software Engineer
tracks.summary: From the notional machine to architecture decisions, testing and working with coding agents.
tracks.capstone: Design, test and ship a small web service with an ADR for each major decision, a test suite that catches a seeded bug, and one feature delegated to a coding agent and independently verified.

tracks.title: Embedded Systems Engineer
tracks.summary: Firmware that meets hardware: registers, timing, interrupts, buses and power.
tracks.capstone: Build a battery-powered sensor node: a debounced button, ADC sampling with filtering, PWM output, an I²C sensor, sleep between readings, and a measured battery-life estimate.

tracks.title: Electrical Engineer
tracks.summary: Circuits, signals and control, on the physics and mathematics they rest on.
tracks.capstone: Design an analogue front end for a sensor: an op-amp gain stage, an anti-aliasing filter chosen from the sample rate, and a PID loop that holds a setpoint, each verified against a hand calculation.

tracks.title: Mechanical Engineer
tracks.summary: Forces into structures, structures into machines that can be made.
tracks.capstone: Design a load-bearing bracket: choose the material by performance index, size it by hand, validate with FEA and a mesh-convergence study, check fatigue and resonance, and tolerance it for manufacture.

tracks.title: Physicist / Research Scientist
tracks.summary: The physics spine with the mathematics to read and derive it.
tracks.capstone: Design and run a measurement (e.g. g from a pendulum at large amplitude), model it from first principles, propagate the uncertainty, and explain the residuals.

tracks.title: Chemist / Chemical Engineer
tracks.summary: Bonding, energetics and equilibrium, through to mechanisms and analysis.
tracks.capstone: Plan a synthesis or process step: balance it, predict yield from equilibrium and kinetics, size the heat removal, and confirm the product with spectroscopy data.

tracks.title: Life Scientist / Biomedical
tracks.summary: Molecules to ecosystems, with the chemistry and statistics a lab biologist needs.
tracks.capstone: Design an experiment (e.g. an enzyme-inhibitor assay or a CRISPR knockout), state the hypothesis, the controls and the statistical test before collecting data, and interpret the result without confusing correlation and cause.

tracks.title: AI Agent Engineer
tracks.summary: Teach agents and prove they learned: specs, evals, skills, independent grading.
tracks.capstone: Teach a subagent a new domain with the DULTA agent-learner protocol: baseline cold-start, notes revised over moves, `leak` clean, an independent grader, normalized gain reported, and the notes installed as a skill.

tracks.title: Educator / Learning Designer
tracks.summary: Design instruction that measurably works, for people and for agents.
tracks.capstone: Design one week of a course with DULTA's Directed Teaching mode: aligned outcomes, activities and assessments (`dulta.py align` clean), a pre/post test with normalized gain, and a panel round on the materials.

tracks.title: AI / Machine Learning Engineer
tracks.summary: Train, evaluate and ship models that generalise, from linear regression to transformers.
tracks.capstone: Train a model on a real dataset with a clean train/validation/test split, show the overfitting curve and how regularisation fixes it, pick the metric that matches the cost of errors, audit error rates across groups, and serve it behind a monitored endpoint.

tracks.title: Data Scientist
tracks.summary: Turn data into decisions you can defend: statistics, experiments and models.
tracks.capstone: Answer a real business or science question end to end: pre-register the hypothesis and metric, query and clean the data, run the analysis or experiment, and present the result with its uncertainty and the confounders you ruled out.

tracks.title: Game Developer
tracks.summary: Real-time simulation that feels good: loops, physics, rendering, AI and netcode inside a 16 ms budget.
tracks.capstone: Ship a small playable game: a fixed-timestep loop, collisions without tunnelling, an enemy that pathfinds with A*, a stable 60 fps measured with a profiler, and two rounds of silent playtesting that change the design.

tracks.title: Plant Geneticist / Breeder
tracks.summary: Breed better crops: inheritance, quantitative genetics, markers, gene editing and field trials.
tracks.capstone: Design a breeding programme for one trait (e.g. drought tolerance): estimate heritability, predict gain per cycle with the breeder's equation, choose markers or genomic selection, lay out a multi-site randomised trial, and plan release to farmers.

tracks.title: Agricultural Robotics Engineer
tracks.summary: Robots that work in fields: sensing through dust and changing light, navigating rows, handling plants gently.
tracks.capstone: Specify and simulate a weeding or scouting robot for one crop: sensors and RTK positioning, a Kalman-filtered pose, a coverage path with obstacle detours, crop–weed detection evaluated on a different field, a safety case, and a payback estimate against labour cost.

tracks.title: Robotics Engineer
tracks.summary: Sense, estimate, plan and act: kinematics, control, sensor fusion and robot software.
tracks.capstone: Build a mobile robot that maps a room and returns to its dock: wheel odometry fused with an IMU or lidar, SLAM with loop closure, A* planning, PID control, and an emergency stop tested on purpose.

tracks.title: Telecoms Engineer
tracks.summary: Bits through noisy channels: decibels, modulation, Shannon, coding, fibre and cellular networks.
tracks.capstone: Design a wireless link end to end: a link budget with fade margin, a modulation and code rate chosen against measured SNR, the capacity against Shannon's limit, and a demonstration on a software-defined radio.

tracks.title: Quantum Researcher
tracks.summary: Quantum mechanics as a computing resource: amplitudes, interference, entanglement and error correction.
tracks.capstone: Implement and analyse a small algorithm (Deutsch–Jozsa or 2-qubit Grover) on a simulator and on noisy hardware, explain the interference that makes it work, and quantify how decoherence degrades the result.

tracks.title: Civil & Structural Engineer
tracks.summary: Structures that stand, ground that holds, water that drains and roads that move.
tracks.capstone: Design a short-span footbridge over a stream: load paths and limit-state checks, a truss sized from member forces, foundations chosen from the soil's effective stress, and a culvert and channel sized for the 100-year storm runoff.

tracks.title: Aerospace Engineer
tracks.summary: Aircraft and spacecraft: aerodynamics, propulsion, flight dynamics and orbital mechanics.
tracks.capstone: Size a small UAV or a cubesat mission: a drag polar and best-L/D speed with Breguet range (or a launch, Hohmann transfer and Δv budget through the rocket equation), a stability check from CG and neutral point, and a fatigue or thermal margin.

tracks.title: Environmental Scientist / Engineer
tracks.summary: Measure and protect water, air and climate: monitoring, modelling and remediation.
tracks.capstone: Assess a river below a town: design a monitoring plan, fit an oxygen-sag model to the samples, size the treatment upgrade that keeps oxygen above 5 mg/L in summer, model the catchment's flood response, and report the life-cycle trade-offs.

tracks.title: Climate Scientist
tracks.summary: Energy balance, feedbacks and the long record of Earth's climate.
tracks.capstone: Estimate climate sensitivity two ways, from an energy-balance model fitted to the instrumental record and from a paleoclimate interval, then reconcile them, with uncertainties and the feedbacks that dominate them.

tracks.title: Geoscientist
tracks.summary: Read rocks, quakes and deep time to find resources and manage hazards.
tracks.capstone: Produce a hazard and resource assessment for a region: a geological map and history with radiometric ages, earthquakes located from station records, a gravity survey interpreted for a buried body, and a risk map combining hazard, exposure and vulnerability.
